name: sevdesk-mcp
description: Unofficial, not affiliated with sevdesk GmbH. Curated, read-only-by-default tools for the sevdesk accounting API: invoices, contacts, vouchers, banking.
long_description:
Unofficial, not affiliated with sevdesk GmbH.

The API token stays on this computer and is sent only to sevdesk. The mode sets the ceiling: `read` (default) allows only reads, `write` adds drafts, master data and status changes. Tools above the mode are not registered. Irreversible actions (sending e-mail, cancellation, enshrining) are only available in a manual configuration with SEVDESK_MODE=full and SEVDESK_ENABLE_TOOLS, not through this extension.

api_token.title: sevdesk API token
api_token.description: 32 hex characters; sevdesk issues one per administrator.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: read (default) or write. read allows only reads, write adds drafts, master data and status changes. Irreversible actions (sending e-mail, cancellation, enshrining) are only available in a manual configuration with SEVDESK_MODE=full and SEVDESK_ENABLE_TOOLS.
